message: Renovate proposes updates after 1 day (minimumReleaseAge: "1 day" in packageRules[0] of renovate.json), but Bundler waits 1 week (cooldown: 7 in Gemfile); its pull requests bring in versions younger than Bundler accepts, or fail where the lockfile is re-checked
fix: Make minimumReleaseAge in packageRules[0] of renovate.json at least 1 week, or limit the rule to the packages that need a shorter delay
